title: सप्तत्यधिकद्विशततमोऽध्यायः

summary.en: Prahasta strikes Vibhishana with his mace and is slain by him, and Hanuman kills Dhumraksha. Shaken, Ravana wakes Kumbhakarna from his long sleep and sends him out to battle.
summary.kn: ಪ್ರಹಸ್ತನು ವಿಭೀಷಣನನ್ನು ಗದೆಯಿಂದ ಹೊಡೆದು ಅವನಿಂದಲೇ ಹತನಾಗುತ್ತಾನೆ; ಹನುಮಂತನು ಧೂಮ್ರಾಕ್ಷನನ್ನು ಕೊಲ್ಲುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಕಳವಳಗೊಂಡ ರಾವಣನು ಕುಂಭಕರ್ಣನನ್ನು ದೀರ್ಘನಿದ್ರೆಯಿಂದ ಎಬ್ಬಿಸಿ ಯುದ್ಧಕ್ಕೆ ಕಳುಹಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ.
summary.hi: प्रहस्त विभीषण पर गदा से प्रहार करता है और उन्हीं के हाथों मारा जाता है, और हनुमान धूम्राक्ष को मारते हैं। विचलित रावण कुम्भकर्ण को दीर्घ निद्रा से जगाकर युद्ध में भेजता है।
summary.te: ప్రహస్తుడు విభీషణుని గదతో కొట్టి అతని చేతనే హతుడవుతాడు; హనుమంతుడు ధూమ్రాక్షుని చంపుతాడు. కలవరపడిన రావణుడు కుంభకర్ణుని దీర్ఘనిద్ర నుండి లేపి యుద్ధానికి పంపుతాడు.
summary.ta: ப்ரஹஸ்தன் விபீஷணனைக் கதையால் தாக்கி அவனாலேயே கொல்லப்படுகிறான்; ஹனுமான் தூம்ராக்ஷனைக் கொல்கிறார். கலங்கிய ராவணன் கும்பகர்ணனை நீண்ட உறக்கத்திலிருந்து எழுப்பிப் போருக்கு அனுப்புகிறான்.
summary.ml: പ്രഹസ്തൻ വിഭീഷണനെ ഗദകൊണ്ട് പ്രഹരിക്കുന്നു, പക്ഷേ വിഭീഷണനാൽ തന്നെ വധിക്കപ്പെടുന്നു; ഹനുമാൻ ധൂമ്രാക്ഷനെ കൊല്ലുന്നു. ഞെട്ടിപ്പോയ രാവണൻ കുംഭകർണ്ണനെ ദീർഘനിദ്രയിൽനിന്ന് ഉണർത്തി യുദ്ധത്തിന് അയക്കുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 3.270; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Mon Apr 11 2022

verses.text: मार्कण्डेय उवाच

meaning.en: Markandeya said:

verses.text:
ततः प्रहस्तः सहसा समभ्येत्य विभीषणम् ।
गदया ताडयामास विनद्य रणकर्कशः ॥

meaning.en: Then Prahasta suddenly came at Vibhishana and, roaring, struck him with a mace, harsh in battle.

verses.text:
स तयाभिहतो धीमान्गदया भीमवेगया ।
नाकम्पत महाबाहुर्हिमवानिव सुस्थिरः ॥

meaning.en: Struck by that mace of dreadful force, the wise, mighty-armed Vibhishana did not tremble, as firm as the Himalaya.

verses.text:
ततः प्रगृह्य विपुलां शतघण्टां विभीषणः ।
अभिमन्त्र्य महाशक्तिं चिक्षेपास्य शिरः प्रति ॥

meaning.en: Then Vibhishana took up a huge hundred-belled great spear, consecrated it with a mantra, and hurled it at Prahasta's head.

verses.text:
पतन्त्या स तया वेगाद्राक्षसोऽशनिनादया ।
हृतोत्तमाङ्गो ददृशे वातरुग्ण इव द्रुमः ॥

meaning.en: As it fell with a thunderbolt's sound, the rakshasa, his head struck off, looked like a tree felled by the wind.

verses.text:
तं दृष्ट्वा निहतं संख्ये प्रहस्तं क्षणदाचरम् ।
अभिदुद्राव धूम्राक्षो वेगेन महता कपीन् ॥

meaning.en: Seeing Prahasta, the night-wanderer, killed in battle, Dhumraksha rushed with great speed at the monkeys.

verses.text:
तस्य मेघोपमं सैन्यमापतद्भीमदर्शनम् ।
दृष्ट्वैव सहसा दीर्णा रणे वानरपुंगवाः ॥

meaning.en: Seeing his army, like a cloud and fearful to look at, the monkey bulls were suddenly scattered in the battle.

verses.text:
ततस्तान्सहसा दीर्णान्दृष्ट्वा वानरपुंगवान् ।
निर्याय कपिशार्दूलो हनूमान्पर्यवस्थितः ॥

meaning.en: Seeing those chief monkeys suddenly scattered, Hanuman, tiger among monkeys, came forward and stood firm.

verses.text:
तं दृष्ट्वावस्थितं संख्ये हरयः पवनात्मजम् ।
वेगेन महता राजन्संन्यवर्तन्त सर्वशः ॥

meaning.en: Seeing the son of the wind standing in battle, the monkeys, king, turned back everywhere with great speed.

verses.text:
ततः शब्दो महानासीत्तुमुलो लोमहर्षणः ।
रामरावणसैन्यानामन्योन्यमभिधावताम् ॥

meaning.en: Then a great, tumultuous, hair-raising sound arose from the armies of Rama and Ravana as they ran against one another.

verses.text:
तस्मिन्प्रवृत्ते संग्रामे घोरे रुधिरकर्दमे ।
धूम्राक्षः कपिसैन्यं तद्द्रावयामास पत्रिभिः ॥

meaning.en: When that terrible battle, a mire of blood, began, Dhumraksha scattered the monkey army with arrows.

verses.text:
तं राक्षसमहामात्रमापतन्तं सपत्नजित् ।
तरसा प्रतिजग्राह हनूमान्पवनात्मजः ॥

meaning.en: Hanuman, the son of the wind, conqueror of enemies, stoutly met that chief rakshasa as he came on.

verses.text:
तयोर्युद्धमभूद्घोरं हरिराक्षसवीरयोः ।
जिगीषतोर्युधान्योन्यमिन्द्रप्रह्लादयोरिव ॥

meaning.en: A terrible fight began between the monkey hero and the rakshasa hero, each eager to win, like Indra and Prahlada.

verses.text:
गदाभिः परिघैश्चैव राक्षसो जघ्निवान्कपिम् ।
कपिश्च जघ्निवान्रक्षः सस्कन्धविटपैर्द्रुमैः ॥

meaning.en: The rakshasa struck the monkey with maces and iron clubs, and the monkey struck the rakshasa with trees, with trunks and branches.

verses.text:
ततस्तमतिकायेन साश्वं सरथसारथिम् ।
धूम्राक्षमवधीद्धीमान्हनूमान्मारुतात्मजः ॥

meaning.en: Then wise Hanuman, son of the wind, killed Dhumraksha with his horses, chariot, and charioteer, with a great blow.

verses.text:
ततस्तं निहतं दृष्ट्वा धूम्राक्षं राक्षसोत्तमम् ।
हरयो जातविस्रम्भा जघ्नुरभ्येत्य सैनिकान् ॥

meaning.en: Seeing the best of rakshasas, Dhumraksha, killed, the monkeys regained confidence and went after the soldiers, killing them.

verses.text:
ते वध्यमाना बलिभिर्हरिभिर्जितकाशिभिः ।
राक्षसा भग्नसंकल्पा लङ्कामभ्यपतन्भयात् ॥

meaning.en: Struck down by the strong, fast monkeys, the rakshasas, their resolve broken, fled in fear into Lanka.

verses.text:
तेऽभिपत्य पुरं भग्ना हतशेषा निशाचराः ।
सर्वं राज्ञे यथावृत्तं रावणाय न्यवेदयन् ॥

meaning.en: The shattered night-wanderers, those left alive, ran into the city and reported to King Ravana everything that had happened.

verses.text:
श्रुत्वा तु रावणस्तेभ्यः प्रहस्तं निहतं युधि ।
धूम्राक्षं च महेष्वासं ससैन्यं वानरर्षभैः ॥

meaning.en: Hearing from them that Prahasta had been killed in the battle, and Dhumraksha too, the great archer with his army, by the monkey chiefs,

verses.text:
सुदीर्घमिव निःश्वस्य समुत्पत्य वरासनात् ।
उवाच कुम्भकर्णस्य कर्मकालोऽयमागतः ॥

meaning.en: Ravana sighed deeply, sprang up from his fine seat, and said, "Now it is time for Kumbhakarna's work."

verses.text:
इत्येवमुक्त्वा विविधैर्वादित्रैः सुमहास्वनैः ।
शयानमतिनिद्रालुं कुम्भकर्णमबोधयत् ॥

meaning.en: Having said this, he woke the sleeping Kumbhakarna, who was deeply asleep, with various instruments of great sound.

verses.text:
प्रबोध्य महता चैनं यत्नेनागतसाध्वसः ।
स्वस्थमासीनमव्यग्रं विनिद्रं राक्षसाधिपः ।
ततोऽब्रवीद्दशग्रीवः कुम्भकर्णं महाबलम् ॥

meaning.en: When he had been woken with great effort, with fear gone, and sat comfortably, calm and fully awake, the ten-necked lord of the rakshasas spoke to mighty Kumbhakarna.

verses.text:
धन्योऽसि यस्य ते निद्रा कुम्भकर्णेयमीदृशी ।
य इमं दारुणं कालं न जानीषे महाभयम् ॥

meaning.en: "You are blessed, Kumbhakarna, to have such sleep, that you do not know this terrible time of great peril.

verses.text:
एष तीर्त्वार्णवं रामः सेतुना हरिभिः सह ।
अवमन्येह नः सर्वान्करोति कदनं महत् ॥

meaning.en: This Rama has crossed the ocean by a bridge with the monkeys, and, scorning us all, is making great slaughter here.

verses.text:
मया ह्यपहृता भार्या सीता नामास्य जानकी ।
तां मोक्षयिषुरायातो बद्ध्वा सेतुं महार्णवे ॥

meaning.en: I took his wife, Sita, Janaka's daughter, and he has come to free her, having built a bridge across the great sea.

verses.text:
तेन चैव प्रहस्तादिर्महान्नः स्वजनो हतः ।
तस्य नान्यो निहन्तास्ति त्वदृते शत्रुकर्शन ॥

meaning.en: By him our great kinsmen, Prahasta and the others, have been killed. No one but you can kill him, scorcher of foes.

verses.text:
स दंशितोऽभिनिर्याय त्वमद्य बलिनां वर ।
रामादीन्समरे सर्वाञ्जहि शत्रूनरिंदम ॥

meaning.en: So arm yourself and go out today, best of the strong, and kill Rama and all those enemies in battle, tamer of foes.

verses.text:
दूषणावरजौ चैव वज्रवेगप्रमाथिनौ ।
तौ त्वां बलेन महता सहितावनुयास्यतः ॥

meaning.en: Dushana's two younger brothers, Vajravega and Pramathin, will follow you with a great force."

verses.text:
इत्युक्त्वा राक्षसपतिः कुम्भकर्णं तरस्विनम् ।
संदिदेशेतिकर्तव्ये वज्रवेगप्रमाथिनौ ॥

meaning.en: Having said this to the mighty Kumbhakarna, the lord of the rakshasas instructed Vajravega and Pramathin about what was to be done.

verses.text:
तथेत्युक्त्वा तु तौ वीरौ रावणं दूषणानुजौ ।
कुम्भकर्णं पुरस्कृत्य तूर्णं निर्ययतुः पुरात् ॥

meaning.en: Saying "So be it" to Ravana, the two heroes, Dushana's younger brothers, put Kumbhakarna ahead and quickly went out of the city.
